name: Tailscale

install_consent_messages.en: The Tailscale container joins this machine to your tailnet. It uses host networking, the NET_ADMIN capability and the /dev/net/tun device, so it creates a network interface and changes this machine's routing and firewall rules. Do not install it on a machine that already runs Tailscale.
install_consent_messages.es: El contenedor de Tailscale une esta máquina a tu tailnet. Usa la red del host, la capacidad NET_ADMIN y el dispositivo /dev/net/tun, así que crea una interfaz de red y cambia las rutas y las reglas de firewall de esta máquina. No lo instales en una máquina que ya ejecuta Tailscale.

description: Private network access — reach your Crow from any device without exposing it to the public internet
author: Crow

env_vars.name: TS_AUTHKEY
env_vars.description: Tailscale reusable auth key — generate at https://login.tailscale.com/admin/settings/keys (select 'Reusable')

notes: Creates a private Tailscale tunnel so you can access your Crow at http://crow/ from any device on your Tailnet. Requires a free Tailscale account. Self-hosted only — not available on managed hosting.
